content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) Fortran source of FUNWAVE-TVD misc.F with five program units. SUBROUTINE INDEX (L65-178, Shi 05/06/2010, ProcessorID for periodic bc 01/27/2016): MPI domain decomposition — allocates ProcessorID(PX,PY) (L77), NumberProcessor=px*py, dims/periods/coords setup (L79-90; periodic topology deliberately not used because the TRID solver is not cyclic, comments L85-87); ykchoi guard aborting via MPI_FINALIZE when mpirun processor count /= Px*Py (L93-101); MPI_CART_CREATE/MPI_CART_COORDS (L103-105) giving npx,npy (L107-108); MPI_Cart_shift for n_west/n_east and n_suth/n_nrth neighbors (L110-111); ProcessorID(I,J)=icp numbering with myidi/myidj capture (L113-124); tile ranges via grid_range_per_procs for x and y (L137-138) replacing the old Mloc=Mglob/px+2*Nghost form (commented L134-135); Mloc=(iiend-iista+1)+2*Nghost, Nloc likewise (L140-141); rank-0 writes 'Grid_Range.out' (unit 500) listing each core's istart/iend/jstart/jend after mpi_gather x4 (L144-163); Mloc1=Mloc+1, Nloc1=Nloc+1, Ibeg=Nghost+1, Iend=Mloc-Nghost, Iend1=Mloc1-Nghost, Jbeg/Jend/Jend1 (L168-176). subroutine grid_range_per_procs(n1,n2,nprocs,myid,stag,endg) (L181-204, Shi copied from Chois codes 05/10/2017): block partition inum1=int((n2-n1+1)/nprocs), inum2=mod(n2-n1+1,nprocs), stag=myid*inum1+n1+min(myid,inum2), endg=stag+inum1-1 plus 1 if inum2>myid (L197-203). SUBROUTINE ESTIMATE_DT(M,N,DX,DY,U,V,H,MinDepthFrc,DT,CFL,TIME) (L216-270, Shi 05/06/2010): CFL time step — over all cells TMP1=|U|+sqrt(g*max(H,MinDepthFrc)) and TMP2=DX/TMP1 (SMALL-guarded), tracking the minimum TMP3 over x and y directions (L231-250), global MPI_ALLREDUCE MIN (L252-254), DT_tmp=CFL*TMP3 (L255); if FIXED_DT, DT starts at DT_fixed and halves until DT<=DT_tmp (L257-262) else DT=DT_tmp (L264); TIME=TIME+DT (L268). SUBROUTINE MAX_MIN_PROPERTY (L281-335, Shi 02/10/2016, based on Chen et al., 2004 per L275): per wet cell updates HeightMax=max(Eta) (L288-292), HeightMin=min(Eta) (L294-298), VelocityMax from maxv=sqrt(U^2+V^2) (L300-305), MomentumFluxMax from maxv=(U^2+V^2)*H (L307-312), and arrival-time matrix (Lauren Schambach 3/2/2020): ARRTIME(I,J)=TIME once |Eta|>ArrTimeMin and no prior value (L313-321); OUT_VORmax branch is empty because vorticity is computed in dispersion.F (comments L326-328), then phi_exch(VorticityMax) (L330-332). SUBROUTINE CHECK_BLOWUP (L346-373, ykchoi 01/23/2015; Shi threshold 100*max_depth 02/15/2016): MaxAbsEta=MAXVAL(|Eta|) over interior, MPI_ALLREDUCE MAX (L353-355); if MaxAbsEta>EtaBlowVal prints 'BlowUp Time, MaxAbsEta=' (L357-362), sets ICOUNT=99998 and calls PREVIEW to dump the blowup state (L363-364), then MPI_ABORT(MPI_COMM_WORLD,9) (switched from MPI_FINALIZE by mayhl 2019/09/04, comments L366-367, call L368). SUBROUTINE wall_time_secs(tcurrent) (L383-416, Gangfeng Ma 09/12/2011): converts date_and_time VALUES into elapsed seconds using a month-length mscale (31/30/29 for leap years via years.eq.4*int(years/4)/28, L399-409) and tcurrent=months*mscale*86400+days*86400+hrs*3600+60*mins+secs+msecs/1000 (L412-413).

verbatim_spans.text: ! dont use periodic because our TRID solver is not based on
print *, '*** STOP :: Number of processors(',nprocs,') in MPIRUN /= Px*Py(',PX*PY,') ***'
!       05/10/2017 Fengyan Shi copied from Chois codes

unresolved: INDEX processor-count guard (L93-101) calls MPI_FINALIZE without STOP — ranks continue into MPI_CART_CREATE after finalize
ESTIMATE_DT uses TMP1,TMP2,TMP3 and loop indices I,J that are not declared locally despite IMPLICIT NONE (L220) — they come from USE PARAM/GLOBAL (cross-file), so the CFL scan is not thread-safe
MAX_MIN_PROPERTY declares MaxAbsEta and omega_0 (L284) but never uses them; OUT_VORmax exchange (L330-332) exchanges VorticityMax which is filled in dispersion.F (cross-file)

wall_time_secs treats months cumulatively as months*mscale (all elapsed months given the CURRENT month's length) — approximation inherent to the formula L412-413; the subroutine is not called anywhere in this file
leap-year test years.eq.4*int(years/4) (L406) ignores century rules
ndims, reorder, comm2d, dims, periods, coords, EtaBlowVal, ICOUNT, ARRTIME, ArrTimeMin etc. are defined in GLOBAL (cross-file)
